diagnostic_close_grid.scope: Retrospective selected13-record A/B windows only; not causal event generation or universal window length
diagnostic_close_grid.finding: Maximum crossing count alone failed to express current direction; no cutoff/count threshold selected.

implemented_research.anchor_birth: First observed saved low/high/close at that exact price in the current seed and source segment. Equal prices share provenance, not votes.
implemented_research.witness: Three alternating strict completed-close side runs after anchor birth; equals neither cross nor reset strict side.
implemented_research.frame: Raw high/low envelope from first strict witness to the saved bar before return; immutable at return time.
implemented_research.bounded_reentry: Return close inside inclusive pre-return frame; return bar wick may extend outside. Side return beyond frame retained as overshoot evidence, not erased.
implemented_research.current_relation: Updated separately with later data; does not erase historical witness or decide formal membership.

counterconstraints: Single ABA round-trip can occur in noise or a directional trend; it proposes a local observation only.
ABC remains a confirmed own interval even when current close is below prior local revisit frames.
G2 can contain local exits while larger manual time scope remains confirmed.
May13 high31.40 is retained even without completed-close crossing of that level.

storage.reason: Lossless normalization: repeated current views -> shared snapshot -> integer episode table references. Geometry/discovery unchanged; final reconstruction independently checked.
